item.title: I salute you
item.description:
I was lucky to lead a participatory research project about mental health and masculinity with adolescent boys and young men in Alexandra. We transformed research findings into a rap song and a stop-motion video, written, performed, and illustrated by the young men themselves.

Read more about the project here:

Ngiyak'Vuma Ntwana / I Salute You

Grandpa

Grandpa, Uncle Bruce, and Dad built the 16 Wellesley solarium in the early 80s. Its tall windows and wooden beams extended the house to the backyard garden. Later in life, with pride, Grandpa would ask me, "Do you know who built that solarium?" He asked me the same question every time we sat together in the solarium.
